title: OrchLaunch External Tools
description: External tool definitions for OrchLaunch. Tools can be referenced from before-launch steps or run directly.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

program.description: Path to the program to execute. Supports ${workspace} and ${orch} variables.

cwd.description: Working directory for the tool. Supports ${workspace} and ${orch} variables.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program.

inherit_env.description: Whether to inherit the parent process environment.

environment.description: Additional environment variables. Supports ${workspace} and ${orch} variables.
